# Review of the Safe Apps permissions layout changes

**Mode:** committed range `1fb2fdc1…HEAD`, read-only: nothing edited, no installs, no tests run, nothing posted. The merge-base is actually `cd3b9fa`, so the review covers the 3 commits after it (`1d0c7bf8`, `b4ec34bd`, `9b3ea5d2`).
**Scope:** 10 files, +170 −20, all under `apps/web/src/components/{safe-apps,settings/SafeAppsPermissions}`.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Verdict** | Ready to open the PR. Nothing blocks it. |
| **Score** | **95 / 100** (3 of 5 findings adjudicated) |
| **What held it down** | One real UX bug in the slider, plus small issues in the two new stories |
| **Fix first** | BUG-001: reset the slider's scroll position when the slide changes |

## Scores by area (worst first)

| Area | Score | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Bugs | 90 | 1 low finding, confirmed |
| DRY | 91 | 2 low findings (1 confirmed with reduced likelihood, 1 not adjudicated) |
| Conventions | 96 | 1 low finding, contested |
| KISS | 98 | 1 nit, not adjudicated |
| Architecture | 100 | Its one finding is the same defect as DRY-001, merged there |
| Regression | 100 | No test, E2E selector or caller depends on the changed classes |
| Testing | 100 | `styles.test.ts` fails if the CSS change is reverted; layout is covered by the new stories on the Argos visual-diff CI job, which `apps/web/AGENTS.md` names as the way to cover layout |
| Security | n/a | No auth, input, secrets or dependency changes |
| Performance | n/a | Only className/CSS changes; no loops or queries |

## Not covered by this review
- No tests or Storybook were run, so nothing was checked in a real browser. BUG-001 is reasoned from the CSS and component code; it was not reproduced.
- The layout at the removed `lg`/`xl` breakpoints (1024–1535px) was not checked visually. That is left to the Argos visual diff.
- `.git/safe-code-review/last-run.tsv` was not written, because you asked for a read-only run. There is no "since your last run" comparison.

## Worth a ticket before or soon after merge

**BUG-001: the next slide keeps the previous slide's scroll position** (P3, Low risk · confirmed by the validator, and the refuter could not defeat it)
`apps/web/src/components/safe-apps/SafeAppsInfoModal/styles.module.css:8`, together with `Slider.tsx:33-51`
- **What:** `.sliderContainer` changed from `overflow: hidden` to `overflow-y: auto`. All slides sit in one row that moves sideways with `translateX`, and every slide is stretched to the height of the tallest one. `nextSlide` and `prevSlide` never reset `scrollTop`, and no `key` forces a remount.
- **What the user sees:** an unknown app requests many permissions. The user scrolls down the permissions list and clicks Continue. The `UnknownAppWarning` slide (`index.tsx:138-149`, `UnknownAppWarning.tsx:22`) opens at the old scroll offset, so it looks blank until they scroll back up. That slide is a safety warning.
- **This PR introduced it.** Before, the container could not scroll at all.
- **Fix:** add a ref on `.sliderContainer` and call `ref.current?.scrollTo({ top: 0 })` in `nextSlide` and `prevSlide`. Or move `overflow-y: auto` onto each `.sliderItem` so every slide scrolls on its own.

## Your call, one row each

| ID | Where | Finding | Adjudication | Suggested fix |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| CNV-001 | `settings/SafeAppsPermissions/index.stories.tsx:12-18` | `local.setItem('SafeApps__browserPermissions', …)` runs when the module is imported and writes to real `localStorage` with no cleanup. `.storybook/preview.tsx` never clears it. The data can leak into `src/stories/pages/settings/safe-apps/SafeApps.stories.tsx`, which renders the same component, so what that page story shows (and what Argos screenshots) depends on which story loaded first. Breaks `apps/web/docs/code-style.md:20`. | **Contested.** The validator returned PARTIAL: it confirmed the leak but corrected which story is affected. The refuter cited `faker.seed` at module scope in 5 stories. My view: that is not a real precedent, because `faker.seed` changes in-memory state while this write persists in browser storage. | Seed the data in a loader, decorator or `play` function, and clear it afterwards |
| DRY-001 (+ARC-001) | `settings/SafeAppsPermissions/index.stories.tsx:12` | Hard-codes the storage key instead of using `BROWSER_PERMISSIONS` from `hooks/safe-apps/permissions/useBrowserPermissions.ts:7`, which is private. If the key is renamed, the story silently seeds nothing. | Confirmed, likelihood lowered to L1: two existing tests hard-code keys the same way (`WcConnectionForm/index.test.tsx:8`, `SafeAppsDashboardSection.test.tsx:37`) | Export the key and import it. The repo already does this with `LOGGING_OUT_KEY` in `useLogoutCallback.ts` |
| DRY-002 | `safe-apps/SafeAppsInfoModal/styles.test.ts:7-11` | A 6th local copy of the postcss `findRule`/`declOf` helpers. The same pair already exists in `common/PageLayout`, `TxModalDialog`, `ModalDialog`, `tx-flow/common/TxLayoutBase` and `TxStatusWidget` `styles.test.ts`. | Not adjudicated (counts at full weight) | Pull them into one shared test util |
| KIS-001 | `settings/SafeAppsPermissions/index.stories.tsx:38` (also `:25`) | `loaders: [mswLoader]` is declared on both the meta and `Default`, so it is registered twice. Sibling stories declare it only on the meta (`ProposersList`, `OwnerList`, `NestedSafesList`). | Not adjudicated (counts at full weight) | `export const Default: Story = {}` |

## Worth tidying (no score impact)
1. **`FEATURES` in `safe-apps/types.ts:9` has no `as const`.** Without it `AllowedFeatures` is just `string`, so every `as AllowedFeatures[]` cast does nothing and a misspelled feature name still type-checks. That includes the new casts in `SafeAppsInfoModal/index.stories.tsx:16,38,46`. The problem predates this PR; the PR only adds `export`. Adding `as const` is a small type-only fix, but it may surface type errors elsewhere.
2. **DRY-002's shared postcss helper** is the natural cleanup across the five older test files.

Left alone on purpose:
- Mixing the CSS module with Tailwind in the Slider was already the pattern before this PR.
- The arbitrary Tailwind values such as `text-[var(--color-…)]` were already there.

## Ruled out
- **Removing `min-height: 100%` from `.sliderItem`:** changes nothing, because the flex default `align-items: stretch` still makes each slide full height.
- **Removing `flex-1` from `PermissionCheckbox`'s `Field`:** changes nothing. `Field` already has `w-full`, and neither consumer relies on flex-grow.
- **Exporting `FEATURES`:** only adds to the API, and the only new users are the two stories.
- **Changed classes:** no Cypress or Playwright selector or `toHaveClass` assertion depends on them (checked `safeapps.pages.js` and `permissions_settings.cy.js`).
- **`postcss`:** already a declared devDependency (`apps/web/package.json:112`).

## How this was produced
- 7 category passes ran in parallel. Security and performance were n/a.
- Raw findings: 1 bugs, 0 regression, 0 testing, 1 architecture, 2 DRY, 1 KISS, 1 conventions.
- ARC-001 was merged into DRY-001. The bugs pass's handoff on the `localStorage` write is covered by CNV-001.
- Adjudicated 3 of 5 findings, each by one agent arguing for it and one arguing against. Result: 1 confirmed, 1 confirmed with reduced likelihood, 1 contested. None were ruled out. DRY-002 and KIS-001 were not adjudicated and count at full weight.

If you want the cleanups: reply `fix 1`, `fix 2`, `ticket` or `skip`. Silence means skip, and nothing gets recorded.
